shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
body: We deliver all across India. Estimated delivery: 5–7 business days.
Delivery is free on prepaid orders of ₹399 or above and on COD orders of ₹599 or above. For smaller orders, the delivery charge is confirmed with you on WhatsApp.
Cash on Delivery orders carry a separate COD charge, shown in your order review. COD charges and delivery charges are different things.
Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to courier delays.

return-policy.title: Return & Refund Policy
body: [EDIT: set your return window] If your item arrives damaged or incorrect, message us on WhatsApp within [7] days of delivery with clear photos or an unboxing video.
Jewellery is a personal-use item, so worn or altered pieces may not be accepted. [EDIT to match your policy]
Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method or via UPI. [EDIT: add refund timeline]

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
body: We collect only what is needed to process your order: your name, WhatsApp number, delivery address and pincode.
Your cart, wishlist and checkout details are stored in your own browser (LocalStorage) on your device. This website does not send them to any server.
When you confirm an order, your details are sent to us through WhatsApp, and WhatsApp's own privacy policy applies to that chat.
